thread:
sam: Quick notes from the testing block on API Keys — recurring confusions: what "presets" do, fear around revoke, and missed copy button on mobile.

claire: Can we ship a minimal set of fixes first?

sam: Yes: 1) Preset pills that expand inline to one-line summaries (not tooltips). 2) Soft-revoke with 10m grace + undo toast. 3) Sticky copy bar on mobile when secret is shown.

raj: For presets, show exact effects: e.g., Embeddings-only -> "Can call /v1/embeddings, cannot generate completions or manage keys." Users wanted that.

mila: Rotation banner: show new secret in a small focusable banner with Copy CTA and checklist: copy, update CI, restart jobs. Mention audit logging.

a11y-bot: Accessibility: when preset expands, set aria-expanded and announce summary via aria-live. When secret revealed, move focus to Copy and announce politely: "API key revealed. Press Copy to copy. This secret will not be shown again." Ensure revoke toast is keyboard reachable with Undo.

claire: Copy for broad perms should be concrete: "This key can create tokens and run model generation. Consider using a scoped preset or a service account."

sam: I'll update the Figma and drop frames in #design-review. Pilot flags for soft-revoke + presets.

raj: Thanks — will triage with eng once frames are in.

mila: Dropping a11y checklist here too.

a11y-bot: Reminder: include code examples for common fail/success calls in the policy preview (curl snippets).
